session_label: Phase 2 — feature-family completeness gate + inference mode
phase_summary: Added inference-mode classification to feature_family_classifier.py; gate correctly blocks high-precision entries on fully-absent critical families without false-blocking hard-critical families that are present.

inference_mode.trigger: feature_names field is absent in all 300 production prediction rows
inference_mode.strategy: A family is MISSING_CONFIRMED if ALL its canonical members appear in missing_feature_names. Otherwise PRESENT_INFERRED (at least one member plausibly available).
inference_mode.partial_family_handling: Partial families (some members present, some missing) are counted as PRESENT_INFERRED. Only fully-absent families block the gate.
inference_mode.key_property: Hard-critical families (mark_price, candles, volume, atr, orderbook, oi_funding, long_short_ratio) are 100% PRESENT_INFERRED — never falsely blocked.

fixes_applied.change: Added inference mode to classify_feature_families: when feature_names is None/empty and missing_feature_names is provided, family is MISSING_CONFIRMED only if ALL canonical members are in missing_feature_names.
Added classification_mode parameter to feature_family_coverage_summary (default 'normal'; set to 'inference_missing_names_only' when inference path used).
Condition 5 now detects when feature_names is absent and sets classification_mode='inference_missing_names_only' for audit transparency.
Added orchestrator_decision_id extraction in ids dict; split paper_ledger_entry_id into FULL_CHAIN_LINEAGE_IDS (deferred BLOCKER-1) separate from REQUIRED_LINEAGE_IDS.

pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.root_cause: Phase 4 raised default min_confidence to 0.75; test used 0.72 with no explicit config override. Also required Phase 4 multi-TF/OB checks not disabled.
pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.fix: Added min_confidence=0.70, require_multi_tf_agreement=False, require_orderbook_confirmation=False to test config.

pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.root_cause: Phase 4 added multi-TF and orderbook checks; test config did not disable them. Also feature-family gate required all 12 families.
pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.fix: Added require_full_feature_coverage=False, require_multi_tf_agreement=False, require_orderbook_confirmation=False to test config.

pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.root_cause: REQUIRED_LINEAGE_IDS included orchestrator_decision_id and paper_ledger_entry_id but runtime.py ids dict did not extract orchestrator_decision_id. Test payload also missing orchestrator_decision_id.
pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.fix: Added orchestrator_decision_id extraction; moved paper_ledger_entry_id to FULL_CHAIN_LINEAGE_IDS; added orchestrator_decision_id to test payload.

pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.root_cause: Test signals used timeframe=1m which is blocked by Phase 3 entry gate default (allows 15m/1h/4h only).
pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.fix: Changed timeframe from 1m to 15m in _signal() helper.
Changed timeframe from 1m to 15m in test payload.

pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.root_cause: v2_backtest_runner.py (dev/research tool) has add_argument(--symbol, default=BTCUSDT). This is legitimate for a dev tool but was not in the allowlist.
pre_existing_test_failures_fixed.fix: Added v2_backtest_runner.py to ACTIVE_RUNTIME_CLI_DRIFT_ALLOWLIST with comment.

safety_invariants.inference_mode_conservative: partial families are PRESENT to avoid false blocking hard-critical data
safety_invariants.inference_mode_auditable: classification_mode field in feature_coverage dict logs which path was used
safety_invariants.gate_blocked_families_explicit: MISSING_FEATURE_FAMILIES reason string lists all blocked family names

root_cause_of_missing_families.liquidation_clusters: On-chain liquidation cluster data feed (Coinglass/Hyperliquid) not yet wired to feature pipeline
root_cause_of_missing_families.paper_context: paper_position_present, paper_unrealized_bps, risk_recent_allow_rate, orchestrator_recent_allow_rate not yet written to feature snapshot by paper_online_runtime
root_cause_of_missing_families.public_intel: Nansen, Lunarcrush, AICoin, Surf external data feeds not connected to feature pipeline

phase_3_description: High-precision entries are now blocked when critical families missing; next sprint should wire paper_context features into paper_online_runtime feature snapshot
